description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneDetails" name="Phone model and fault details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MaterialsToolsChoices" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RepairInstructions" name="Repair instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FriendsRequest" name="Request to borrow or buy items"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PhoneForExpert" name="Phone sent for expert repair"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_DIYRepair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter phone model and what is broken"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices" messageRef="Message_MaterialsToolsChoices"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AccountForOwnedItems" name="Account for items already owned"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContactFriends" name="Can items be borrowed or bought cheaply from friends?" default="Flow_SkipFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends to borrow or buy items cheaply" messageRef="Message_FriendsRequest"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FriendsMerge" name="Continue sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyRemainingItems" name="Buy the rest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive instructions for fixing the phone" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FixPhone" name="Fix the phone"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairOutcome" name="Did the repair work?" default="Flow_RepairFailed"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReviewOrVideo" name="Send a review and/or video of the repair"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" name="Send the phone to an expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RepairWorked" name="Repair worked and feedback sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_SentToExpert" name="Phone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Enter" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enter_Lists" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Owned" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_AccountForOwnedItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Owned_Friends" sourceRef="Task_AccountForOwnedItems" targetRef="Gateway_ContactFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Items can be borrowed or bought cheaply from friends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipFriends" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContactFriends_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Buy" sourceRef="Gateway_FriendsMerge" targetRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Buy_Instructions" sourceRef="Task_BuyRemainingItems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instructions_Fix" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_FixPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fix_Outcome" sourceRef="Task_FixPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairWorked" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendReviewOrVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The repair worked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairFailed" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairOutcome" targetRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Feedback_End" sourceRef="Task_SendReviewOrVideo" targetRef="End_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Expert_End" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="End_SentToExpert"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_SmartphoneRepair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_DIYer" name="DIYer" processRef="Process_DIYRepair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineTool" name="Online tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SubmitDetails" name="Phone model and fault details" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Participant_OnlineTool" messageRef="Message_PhoneDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProvideLists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineTool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists" messageRef="Message_MaterialsToolsChoices"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProvideInstructions" name="Repair instructions" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineTool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" messageRef="Message_RepairInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_FriendsRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert" sourceRef="Task_SendPhoneToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert" messageRef="Message_PhoneForExpert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
